Our Expertise / Digital Dentistry

Digital Dentistry

Technology that supports a better-informed plan. Our digital tools help us see, plan and coordinate different stages of care, with clinical judgement guiding every decision.

Guided surgery

How it works

01

CBCT imaging

A detailed three-dimensional view of the jawbone and surrounding structures, when clinically indicated.

02

Intraoral scan

A small handheld scanner creates a digital model of your teeth and bite, often without traditional impression trays.

03

3D planning

We bring the information together to plan implant positions with the intended final teeth in mind.

Surgical guides

Created from your digital implant plan

Help direct the drill to the planned position

Planned around your final teeth

Dynamic navigation

Shows instruments on screen in real time

Lets the dentist monitor placement

Allows adjustments during surgery
